title: Render one timeline cell per cycle and row with agreement backgrounds

comments.author: home
comments.text: Changed operational projection to a single shared x-position per cycle. Each row aggregates recorded events into one full-width cycle cell; model predictions and human labels use green match, red disagreement, grey unreviewed backgrounds without circle icons. Cell drill-down preserves every request/response and event; count cells show final configuration for that cycle. Verified prediction exchange and optimizer context through browser. No model calls or source recording changes.
